channel.title: Podcasts — Awesome Bharat
channel.description: Curated podcasts made by Indians — featured on Awesome Bharat.

item.title: The Ranveer Show
item.description: The Ranveer Show is India's most popular solo podcast, hosted by Ranveer Allahbadia (BeerBiceps) — featuring candid conversations with icons from business, sports, cinema, spirituality, and science.

item.title: The Seen and The Unseen
item.description: The Seen and The Unseen is India's sharpest longform podcast, hosted by Amit Varma — exploring Indian society, politics, economics, and culture through deep, witty, and intellectually honest conversations.
